purpose: Optional explicit-root-authorized once-only OS-owned demand launch of the new r3 owner, independent of the tool's execution session. This is not a recurring monitor/notifier, solver trajectory, build, native smoke, physical gate or completion receipt.
guards: Exact immutable interruption audit1200299B SHA25615c9b4fb9e23f8e89c540db9ccf2aadb0b68ff48934109613bf63f86716c8160; no invented r2 exit/completion.

Require unchanged selected r2 helper and component program; Debug helper equals the interrupted audit. Release additionally requires fresh r3 Debug offline pass. The actual r3 owner independently rehashes the original110+1/265/archive/runtime/metadata closure.
Require no active DualSPHysics/upl_/compute-sanitizer project processes before registration and again immediately before Run.
All own claim/XML/registration/launch/start/call/run/log/memcheck/output paths must be fresh. No overwrite, deletion, legacy task stop, automatic retry or fallback.

task.name: GeoDualSPH_upl_cryer_component_{Debug|Release}_r3_20261103
task.registration: TASK_CREATE=2 only; never UPDATE or CREATE_OR_UPDATE. Existing task collision or registration permission failure is retained without Run/fallback.
task.account: Current Windows user SID, InteractiveToken3, RunLevel0 LeastPrivilege. Normalize the actual Principal.UserId (SID or NTAccount representation) back to its exact SID and require current SID equality. No password, administrator elevation, service-account switch or global policy change.
task.action: SystemDirectory/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe with -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -File absolute run_r3.ps1 -Configuration selected -ExecutionAuthorized; exact argv/string/cwd and shell/owner/note/helper/program/audit hashes recorded.
task.multiple_instances: IgnoreNew=2; no second queued or parallel instance.
task.execution_time_limit: PT2H; hard termination enabled at task limit. Hitting this limit is an interruption, never a passing native exit.

evidence.attempt: Fresh *.task_attempt.json is written before registration and blocks accidental replay; it does not claim registration or Run occurred.
evidence.registered: Fresh exported actual *.task.xml and *.task_registered.json after actual COM definition verification but before Run; rehash inputs and compare re-queried actual XML immediately before the one Run.
evidence.launch: Fresh *.task_launch.json records actual COM Run invocation/return, instance GUID, engine PID/state and observed scheduler LastTaskResult/LastRunTime. These are scheduler facts, not native tool/target exit or physical acceptance.
evidence.actual_native: The r3 owner independently records own real PID/parent/creationUTC then captures the direct native tool's typed LASTEXITCODE immediately into call.json before completion analysis. Debug owns sanitizer exit, not an independently captured target exit.
evidence.failure: No Run if registration fails. If Run was invoked but its RPC/instance query fails, start state is uncertain: inspect task/processes rather than call it not started or retry. No automatic deletion/relaunch. A registered but unrun task may remain for root diagnosis.

limitations: InteractiveToken requires the same user to remain logged on. This does not promise survival across logoff, reboot, OS termination, resource exhaustion or task deadline.
WindowStyle Hidden suppresses the launch window; native child priority is not independently observed. The existing owner requests BelowNormal.
A launcher success only means one demand Run was submitted. Actual owner/call/completion/strict offline metadata/CSV/memcheck gates remain required.
No helper build, producer, native decoder, analysis main or TaskScheduler API was executed by the author. Root must finish full source/note review and separately decide whether to use this launcher.
No production/formal/canonical/server data or old worker/task changed. Unrelated worktree dirt remains protected.
